verdict.rationale: Signifyd provides a well-documented REST API with authentication, multiple functional endpoints (Sale, Checkout, GetDecision, Chargeback, Representment), webhooks, SDKs, and even sensitive-data protections, all publicly documented on a dedicated developer portal. Missing for 10: no evidence of machine-readable API spec (e.g., OpenAPI) or explicit agent/AI-oriented tooling like llms.txt (which returned 404), and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
